pathway_name: Karnataka Polytechnic Diploma - Merit-based (SSLC marks) via DTE Karnataka
eligibility: Must have passed Karnataka SSLC or an equivalent recognized Class 10 exam; candidates from boards other than Karnataka SSLC reportedly need an eligibility certificate from the Board of Technical Examinations, Bangalore (per secondary sources, unverified)
admission_route: STRUCTURAL DIFFERENCE from AP/Telangana's POLYCET: Karnataka has no dedicated entrance exam for direct 1st-year diploma admission. Seats are allotted via centralised online counselling by the Dept of Collegiate & Technical Education (DTE Karnataka), purely on SSLC-marks merit within each reservation category. Karnataka's 'DCET' (Diploma Common Entrance Test, conducted by the Karnataka Examinations Authority) is a SEPARATE exam used only for lateral entry into the 2nd year of B.E./B.Tech programmes, not for direct diploma admission - multiple sources confirm this distinction
application_window: unverified - needs follow-up; one 2026 secondary guide estimates online application opening 2nd week of May 2026 with deadline in the 3rd week of May 2026 - no official notification independently reached (dtek.karnataka.gov.in / dtetech.karnataka.gov.in not resolvable this session)
leads_to: Diploma certificate - direct employment, OR lateral entry into 2nd year B.E./B.Tech via DCET, OR further KCET/COMEDK-based degree admission
source: starofmysore.com, 'Applications invited for Diploma courses'; collegesimplified.in, 'Diploma Admission Process After 10th in Karnataka in 2026'; puranmurti.com, 'Karnataka Polytechnic Admission 2026'; collegedunia.com, Karnataka Government Polytechnic Mangalore admission page (DTE centralised counselling on SSLC merit); collegedunia.com / collegedunia exam page on Karnataka DCET (confirms DCET = lateral-entry-only exam) - unverified, official DTE Karnataka portal not independently reached this session
